meta.description: Ismael Sarmiento designs and builds governed, reliable data and AI platforms, and founded IsAcademy to teach people to think with data and AI. CV Online, academy and open source.
lead: I design and build governed, reliable data and AI platforms that help organisations make better decisions and grow with real impact.
about.title: About me
about.0: For almost a decade I have been building data platforms: first in banking (BBVA Next Technologies, Santander Global Tech), then at StratioBD and today at Savana, where I lead Data Management in digital health.
about.1: I am obsessed with data people can trust: governed, interoperable (HL7 FHIR, OMOP CDM) and with measurable quality (UNE 0081). I hold the CDMP certification from DAMA International.
about.2: And because learning is still human, I founded IsAcademy to teach people to think with data and AI.
